entry.dc:title: Screening automation with transformer models: a multi-review evaluation
entry.dc:description: Transformer-based classifiers were evaluated as title and abstract screeners across six completed reviews, reaching recall above 0.95 in five.
entry.dc:creator: Kaz E.

entry.dc:title: A crowd-plus-model pipeline for review screening
entry.dc:description: Non-expert crowd judgements combined with a machine-learning ranker matched expert recall at a third of the cost on two case-study reviews.
entry.dc:creator: Novak P.

entry.dc:title: Query expansion for biomedical search using large language models
entry.dc:description: A large language model proposed synonyms and related concepts for a seed query, improving reference-set recall by twelve points at a modest precision cost.
entry.dc:creator: Deng W.

entry.dc:title: Automated risk-of-bias assessment: a validation study
entry.dc:description: A model answered RoB2 signalling questions from trial full texts with moderate agreement against human consensus judgements.
entry.dc:creator: Ricci M.
